count_unit: unaugmented unique source-supported complete structures; genuine structural variants allowed within families; coefficient-only and augmentation variants excluded
source_spatial_requirement: native/source-supported 2D; explicit general-n source admitting n=2 allowed; no 1D padding
exclusion: direct Cylinder governing system and structurally near variants; source/AST review rather than whole-family ban
coefficient_policy: stage1-compatible unsigned fitted outer-term structure; original signed/coefficient formula kept as evidence; preserve internal nonlinear structure, powers, derivative orders
top3_selection: validation only; integrity/coverage hard gates, compression/use tradeoffs; freeze before test
family_labels_not_enough: audit coarse mechanisms to prevent cosmetic diversity
augmentation_kind: commutative term/factor permutations, up to32 distinct variants; do not pad duplicates

dimension_evidence.n2_specialization_requires: original model and dimensional assumption explicitly linked; expand vector/complex fields before counting scalar fields; no theorem-validity extrapolation

power_specialization.cap_applies_to: all exponent combinations jointly, not two values per exponent

family_balance_requirement: No fixed category cap; additional distinct structures within existing families are allowed
legacy_reuse_rule: Reuse Stage1/old-Stage2 existing formula choices after source/dimension/normalization/target-leakage checks; preserve origin type; never manufacture a y dependence for a 1D model
fluid_scope: Other systems describing fluid-related scenes are allowed when materially different from the Cylinder incompressible NS target; only direct target and close structural variants excluded

axis_role_review.generic_xy_without_physical_or_stationar: HOLD; source tracing required before admission
axis_role_review.source_defines_one_axis_as_time: exclude from native-2D pool unless original independently defines a two-space-dimensional model

current_scope: Complete collection >=212 structures, >=80 three-field, full math review, source-grouped upstream vocabulary selection; no generator formal pretraining or main experiment in this scope
